title: This Shrimp Snaps Its Claw and Makes a Bubble Near the Sun's Temperature
subject: pistol shrimp

scenes.text: A shrimp the size of your finger can stun fish without touching them.
The pistol shrimp snaps its claw shut so fast it shoots a jet of water.
The jet drops the pressure and a bubble forms. Then it collapses with a bang.
That bang is loud, up to around 218 decibels, among the loudest sounds in the sea.
Inside the collapsing bubble, temperature briefly reaches thousands of degrees, close to the Sun's surface.
It even flashes light. The shrimp's weapon is a bubble, not the claw itself.

description:
The pistol shrimp stuns prey with a collapsing bubble, not with its claw.
The bubble produces a bang up to about 218 decibels and a brief flash of light, and a study in Nature put the heat near the Sun's surface temperature.
What's the strangest weapon in the ocean?
thumbnail_text: THE SHRIMP WITH A BUBBLE WEAPON
first_comment: The bubble collapses in a few millionths of a second. Would you want to be a fish near one?
